consequence.statement: A UI bugfix: an error message is now shown when the max pods limit for viewing logs is reached; no operational consequence is stated.

original.statement: The Argo CD UI now shows an error message when the maximum number of pods for viewing logs is reached (UI bugfix).

decision.reason: [ev-ea73ef1da3cb] lists this only as a UI bug fix: the UI now shows an error message when the maximum number of pods for viewing logs is reached. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured, loses access or needs migrating. It also names no changed default or setting that an operator would need to check. A "none" consequence with informational class and low severity matches the evidence.
